items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: I used to go down and see Red Saunders. ... I used to go down to Red's... They used to have breakfast dances down at Red Saunders'.

ctx.x: At this time did you ever go see... Out in Chicago, when you were in Chicago, did you ever go see Red Saunders?
